products.name: Camel Shearling Coat
products.shortDescription: Long single-breasted coat in soft camel merino shearling, with a notched collar and patch pockets.
products.description:
A warm, mid-length coat made from plush merino shearling in a rich camel tone. The dense, soft pile gives it a cosy, luxurious feel while keeping a clean, classic shape.

It has a notched collar, a single-breasted front with four dark horn-style buttons, and two large patch pockets at the front. The smooth suede-finish interior adds comfort and structure. The straight, slightly relaxed cut falls to the knee, so it layers easily over knitwear and looks equally good with dark denim, tailored trousers or boots.

Merino is naturally breathable and temperature-regulating, so the coat is warm without being heavy. Natural variations in the pile and colour are part of the character of each piece.

specs.label: Leather
specs.value: Merino shearling (wool pile with suede-finish backing)

products.name: Black Shearling Aviator Jacket
products.shortDescription: Real leather aviator jacket with a warm merino shearling collar and lining, in black.
products.description:
A classic aviator silhouette made from genuine black leather, lined with soft merino wool for real warmth. The oversized shearling collar can be worn open or fastened with the adjustable buckle strap at the neck.

A heavy metal front zip and two zippered side pockets give it a clean, structured look. The seamed hem band and cuffs add the traditional flight-jacket detail. The relaxed, slightly cropped cut works over knitwear and pairs well with wide-leg denim or tailored trousers.

Merino is naturally breathable and temperature-regulating, so the jacket stays warm without feeling heavy. Each piece has its own natural leather grain, so small variations are part of its character.

specs.value: Real leather, black, with a natural grain

specs.label: Collar
specs.value: Oversized merino shearling collar with buckle strap

products.name: Grey Merinos Jacket
products.shortDescription: Cozy grey suede-look jacket with plush faux-shearling lining and collar.
products.description:
Stay warm in style with this grey suede-effect jacket. The soft, fluffy shearling-style lining covers the collar, cuffs and hem for extra warmth.

Features a classic lapel collar, front button closure, two roomy patch pockets and buckle-strap cuff details. Its relaxed, slightly cropped cut pairs easily with jeans, knitwear and boots.
